name: vaktflyt
description: Rosters, shifts, absence and Norwegian working-time rules from VaktFlyt.

interface.longDescription:
VaktFlyt is a Norwegian workforce-management service for shift scheduling (turnus), absence, shift swaps and compliance with the Norwegian Working Environment Act. This plugin lets a VaktFlyt user work with their own organisation's data from ChatGPT.

The plugin acts as the signed-in user. It sees only what that person can see in VaktFlyt, and the tools it offers follow the person's role (employee, leader, administrator, union representative, data protection officer).

Read tools cover rosters and shifts, employees, organisation and departments, staffing and open shifts, absence and shift swaps, reports on hours and overtime, checks against the Working Environment Act chapter 10, and look-ups in law, collective agreements and VaktFlyt's help texts.

Propose tools never change data. Each call adds to one plan and returns a dry run of the whole plan and an approval link. The user opens the link and approves or discards the plan in VaktFlyt. Approved changes pass the same permission and working-time checks as changes made in the app.

Privacy: information under GDPR Article 9, such as diagnosis and reason for absence, is removed before any answer leaves VaktFlyt. Every call is recorded in the organisation's audit trail. The service is hosted in the EU.

Requirements: a VaktFlyt organisation where an administrator has turned on AI clients (off by default) and recorded the two confirmations Norwegian and EU law require before AI is used at work. Each user then signs in with their own VaktFlyt account and chooses read-only access or read and propose.

Tool titles and most answers are in Norwegian, because VaktFlyt's users are. ChatGPT answers in the user's language.
capabilities: Find open shifts and who is available and qualified to take them
Check a roster against the Norwegian Working Environment Act, with each violation explained
Report hours, overtime and absence for a department or an employee
Draft roster changes that you approve in VaktFlyt before anything happens
Look up law, collective agreements and VaktFlyt's help texts on working time
defaultPrompt: Which shifts are open in my department next week, and who can take them?
Check my department's roster for the next four weeks against the Working Environment Act.
What does the Working Environment Act say about daily rest between two shifts?

positive.description: A leader looks for cover: open shifts in the department and who can take them.
positive.prompt: Which shifts are open in the department Drift between 16 November and 13 December 2026, and who can take them?
positive.tools_triggered: organisation (to find the department), staffing (open shifts and candidates)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the open shifts in Drift in the period (the test organisation has six) with date and time, and for each names employees who are available and qualified. Nothing is changed in VaktFlyt.

positive.description: A leader checks the roster against the Norwegian Working Environment Act.
positive.prompt: Check the roster for the department Drift for the next four weeks against the Working Environment Act and explain any violations.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reports whether the roster has violations of chapter 10 of the Working Environment Act. Each violation is named with the employee, the date and the section of the Act, or ChatGPT states that none were found. Nothing is changed in VaktFlyt.

positive.description: A leader asks for a report on hours and overtime.
positive.prompt: How many hours are planned for each employee in the department Drift from 16 November to 13 December 2026, and is there any overtime?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives hours per employee for the period and says whether any overtime is recorded. Nothing is changed in VaktFlyt.

positive.description: A user asks what the law says about a working-time question.
positive.prompt: What does the Norwegian Working Environment Act say about daily rest between two shifts?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers from VaktFlyt's legal sources: the main rule of 11 consecutive hours of rest in 24 hours (section 10-8), with the conditions for agreeing a shorter rest, and names the section it relies on.

positive.description: A leader drafts a change. The plugin only stores a proposal that the user approves in VaktFlyt.
positive.prompt: Find one open shift in the department Drift in the week of 16 November 2026 and draft a proposal that assigns it to an employee who is available. Give me the approval link.
positive.tools_triggered: staffing or schedule (to find the shift and a candidate), propose_shift_changes
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows a dry run of the plan (which shift, which employee, and the result of the working-time checks) and gives an approval link to VaktFlyt. The shift is not assigned until the user opens the link while signed in to VaktFlyt and approves the plan there.

negative.description: Unrelated to VaktFlyt. ChatGPT should answer without calling the plugin, because the question is not about rosters, shifts, absence or working-time rules.
negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Oslo this weekend?

negative.description: The plugin holds no health information: VaktFlyt stores only the type of an absence, and information under GDPR Article 9 is removed before an answer leaves VaktFlyt. ChatGPT should say that the diagnosis and the reason for an absence are not available through VaktFlyt, and may at most state that an absence is registered.
negative.prompt: Which diagnosis is behind the latest sick leave of an employee in the department Drift?

negative.description: The plugin cannot change or delete data directly. ChatGPT should not claim that anything was deleted. It should explain that changes are made as a proposal the user approves in VaktFlyt, and at most draft such a proposal and give the approval link.
negative.prompt: Delete all shifts in the department Drift next week right now, without asking me for approval.

publication.release_notes: First version. Read tools for rosters, shifts, staffing, absence, reports, compliance and legal look-ups, and propose tools that draft changes for approval in VaktFlyt.
